$comment: L2 Responder agent: Container Apps Contributor on the spoke, owns Sev0-Sev1 and L1 escalations. Applied by scripts/configure-sre-agents.ps1.

skills.name: incident-command
skills.description: Own a Sev0/Sev1 or escalated ticket: accept, size impact, route to a specialist, mitigate, verify, close.

skills.name: escalation-sweep
skills.description: Find Azure Monitor tickets that L1 escalated with [ESCALATE-L2] and are not yet accepted by L2.

skills.name: container-app-health-check
skills.description: Read-only health check of one container app: revisions, platform events, logs, requests, dependencies and metrics.

skills.name: container-app-remediation
skills.description: Approved Container Apps mitigations: revision restart, traffic rollback, bounded scale and resize, with drift notes.

skills.name: spoke-network-diagnostics
skills.description: Read-only diagnosis of private endpoints, private DNS, routing, hub firewall, App Gateway and the ACA environment.

skills.name: weekly-reliability-review
skills.description: Weekly read-only review of incidents, recurring causes, IaC drift, capacity and agent effectiveness.

agents.name: l2-aca-remediator
agents.handoffDescription: Applies one approved Container Apps mitigation (revision restart, traffic rollback, scale, resize) for a named app and verifies it.

agents.name: l2-network-diagnostician
agents.handoffDescription: Read-only diagnosis of connectivity problems: private endpoints, private DNS, routing, firewall, App Gateway.

agents.name: l2-incident-commander
agents.handoffDescription: L2 incident commander for Sev0-Sev1 and escalated Azure Monitor tickets; coordinates specialists and closes tickets.

scheduledTasks.name: escalation-sweep
scheduledTasks.description: Every 30 minutes: pick up tickets L1 escalated with [ESCALATE-L2].
scheduledTasks.prompt: Run the escalation-sweep skill. Accept and handle every pending [ESCALATE-L2] ticket; if none, reply with one line.

scheduledTasks.name: weekly-reliability-review
scheduledTasks.description: Monday 09:00 UTC reliability review with the top 5 improvement actions.
scheduledTasks.prompt: Run the weekly-reliability-review skill for the last 7 days and post the top 5 actions.
